tasks.DefineVariables: Define the three consecutive integers in terms of a variable.
tasks.FormulateEquation: Formulate an equation for the sum of these integers that is a palindrome and less than 220.
tasks.MaximizeLargestInteger: Determine the largest integer in each set of three consecutive integers that form a valid palindrome sum.
tasks.SolveForPalindromes: Find all possible palindromic sums under 220 within the range from 101 to 199.
tasks.ValidateSolution: Ensure the solution meets the criteria of being the greatest possible value for the largest of the three integers.
